rationale: Claimant reports a bicycle was taken without permission from a bike rack at their office building, fitting the definition of theft covered under their renters policy.
claim_summary: Blake Okafor reports theft of a 2024 commuter bike valued at $800 from a bike rack at their office building yesterday morning. Policy POL-1007 (renters, active) covers theft with a $250 deductible and $50,000 limit. Building has security cameras; claimant has not yet requested footage.

case_facts.location: bike rack in front of office building
